DE-SC0024701: Biological routes for synthesizing the industrial platform chemical, propylene

Public Abstract

Biological routes for synthesizing propylene from lignin waste and captured carbon dioxide

Justin A. North, The Ohio State University, Columbus, OH (Principal Investigator)

William R. Cannon, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (Co-Investigator)

In recent years, bacteria like Rhodospeudomonas palustris have been discovered that can utilize lignin monomers for growth and thus serve as promising chassis for upscaling lignin monomers and CO2.

This project will design and implement biosynthetic pathways that convert lignin aromatic acids and CO2 into volatile organic sulfur compounds.
